prose.text: The standard gate set comes first, in test-plan §3 order: `capability-drift` before the default-features workspace nextest, the `--features mcp-server` bindings regen after it, and the base-identity bindings close, since the chunk adds no procedure. The chunk's own entries follow: a source census, a probe that Node 24 is installed, the two live runs of the verb with the load average read around the green one, a read of the report twin, a second bindings close and the scope guard.

The two live runs come after the regen on purpose. The green run executes the `test` stage, which rewrites the bindings and must put them back; the bindings close after it and the scope guard after that are what show the check left the working tree as it found it. The green run costs a browser download of about 1 GB and a full workspace test run; its timeout is one hour.

Absences, each with its reason: - No webview gate and no headful self-verify: no `pulse-app/ui/**` path is in the file lists. The `npm` stage's   writes there (`node_modules`, `dist`) are gitignored. - No boot smoke: no boot or setup path is touched (test-plan §3 Per-chunk gate discipline). - No targeted nextest entry: the workspace entry runs the new pins on every re-run. - No entry for the folded boot-smoke watch: it is an observation, read by the wrap from the CI run the operator   pass reads. - The mutation controls of step 13 change source and revert it, so they are one-shot runs at /implement with both   readings in `evidence/`; the workspace entry guards the same pins on every re-run.

On the untouched tree the chunk's own asserting entries read red, the scope guard aside: the verb answers `not-windows`, the two files still name the hop, and Node 24 is not installed. Each reading is in its entry's `baseline`.

**The operator pass, in this order.** The hygiene entry; the pre-CI commit; the green live entry once more on the committed tree (the local pre-push gate before a push); the build-branch push; the CI read of the pushed tip. A CI red whose only failed check is the boot smoke is the watch's recurrence: it is read by the watch's own terms (`harness-settled.json`, `xvfb.log`), brought to the operator, and not fixed on top.
